_comment: Saved alert, Jinka vocabulary. 'ns' or a missing key means not specified. rent_max is the default cap; rent_max_by_dpt overrides it per department (first two digits of the postal code) with a number or an ordered list of tiers, the first tier whose area_above condition holds giving the cap (a tier without condition always holds; unknown area only matches unconditional tiers). where.dpts = IDF department codes, where.postalCodes = exact postal codes; a listing matches the zone if its department OR its postal code is listed.
